definitions.content: difference between the error of indication and the mean intrinsic error of a measuring instrument

notes.content: Principally, a fault is the result of an undesired change of data contained in or flowing through an electronic measuring instrument.
If a certified measurement standard is not used, a fault is the difference between a single indication during or after a disturbance, and the mean indication at reference conditions prior to test.

definitions.content: différence entre l'erreur d'indication et l'erreur intrinsèque d'un instrument de mesure
